body.name: Component total-effect set
body.construction: For \(E_0\in\mathfrak S_p\), \(\Sigma\in\mathbb S^p_{++}\), and finite \(\mathcal Q\), define \(g_{E'}(\Sigma)=(((I_p-L_{E'}(\Sigma))^{-1})_{ya})_{(a,y)\in\mathcal Q}\) for each \(E'\in\mathcal R(E_0)\), and set \[\mathcal T_{E_0}(\Sigma)=\{g_{E'}(\Sigma):E'\in\mathcal R(E_0)\}.\]
